name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 29 times in 9 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 56 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.88 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
